0022600121.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-2) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1) for their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Bulls 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in fourth place in the Central after a loss, while the Celtics are 7th in the East, 1.5 games back in third place in the Atlantic, and riding a one-game winning streak. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring), and Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost 1-2 to the Celtics, including a 124-105 loss in Boston on February 11, 2026.
